A person who is skilled in making maps
solution:

__
 
• The word **"Calligrapher"** means **a person who writes in an artistic, beautiful, and stylized manner. **(सुलेखक
 
• **"Cartographer"** refers to a person who is skilled in making maps. (मानचित्रकार)
 
 
• **Example: **The **cartographer **updated the world map to include newly discovered territories.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that a person skilled in making maps is a **'Cartographer'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Cartographer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Calligrapher** (सुलेखक): A person who writes in an artistic, beautiful, and stylized manner.

 
 
• **Example:** The **calligrapher** was hired to create elegant wedding invitations.
 
 
 
• **Curator** (संग्रहाध्यक्ष): A person who manages or oversees a museum, library, or other collection.
 
 
• **Example:** The **curator** organized a new exhibit showcasing ancient artifacts.
 
 
 
• **Cacographer** (कुपाठक): A person who has bad handwriting.
 
 
• **Example:** Due to his **cacography**, his notes were difficult to read.
